annotations.text:
FinPay — merchant dashboard + hosted checkout.

Direction: approachable & bright — light surfaces, one confident brand blue, friendly rounded components, colour-coded states. An original visual system, not a clone of any provider.

Type: Bricolage Grotesque (display + big numbers) · Hanken Grotesk (UI) · IBM Plex Mono (IDs, amounts).

Payment detail shows the Risk tab — where the Auto-Clear USP lives.
